source_scope: existing owner Jin10 news_versions cache; no new provider requests
origin_basis: v4.1 continuous run v41_observe_20261117T071145Z; does not reset on process restart

queue.cursor: received_at_utc,item_key,version; job and cursor commit in one transaction
queue.score_result_reconciliation: check original v4.1 complete scores before any recovered inference

snapshot.regular_sessions: exchange calendar; half-day counts as session, fixed 16:15 cutoff retained
snapshot.eligible: received_at <= as_of and scored_at <= as_of; version/rule available by as_of
snapshot.new_at_cutoff: PROSPECTIVE only when actually generated at or after due cutoff by running worker; late is LATE and available at actual generation
snapshot.N1: equal mean of direct-company body segment tones per source article, title fallback; equal mean across algorithmic event groups
snapshot.N2: number of source-observed distinct company event groups; not complete-news count when source continuity unproven
snapshot.future_labels: PENDING until 1-day/5-day horizons mature and verified prices become available; no return labels read in this run

association_review.selection: deterministic source segment order, strata old direct/no-company/multi-company and difficult aliases; freeze source judgments before rule change
association_review.new_aliases: only source-supported unambiguous company names, never inferred products/people or substring ticker hits
